note: Marketing-site foundation palette. These are the ONLY 9 custom properties declared on :root in the compiled Webflow stylesheet and mirrored verbatim in the clone. Nothing may be added here without a histogram/stylesheet citation.

color.primary.usage: body text, dark hero surface, dark button fill, trust/benefit card fill

color.white.usage: card surfaces, dark-surface text, values-card fill

color.celeste.usage: light button fill, tag pill fill, dark-button label, ::selection text

color.peach.usage: press/trust bar fill, mobile nav card, .btn hover fill, footer-right blob

color.ivory.usage: page background (.page-wrapper) on every marketing route

color.olive.usage: hero middle-left stone, footer-left blob, careers hero bottom blob

color.coral.usage: declared and UNUSED on the homepage; first live use is the /parents hero top shape and the /careers hero top shape, plus .tab-trigger_icon

color.sandstone.usage: declared and unused on the homepage; live use is the /trust-safety hero bottom blob and one blog CMS tag colour token

literals.note: Measured literal colours that are NOT :root custom properties. Kept separate so nobody promotes them to brand tokens.

emptyCollection.background.note: Webflow .w-dyn-empty grey box, rendered on purpose where a CMS collection is genuinely empty

gradients.note: There are no gradients anywhere on the marketing site. Two flat SVGs are used as background-image (bullet-organic.svg, join-bg.svg); nothing else.
